passage.text: Pete: Ha ha! Look at this joke about people from the countryside!
passage.reading: ˈpiːt: ˈhɑː ˈhɑː! ˈlʊk ət ðɪs ˈdʒoʊk əˈbaʊt ˈpiːpəl frəm ðə ˈkʌntrisaɪd!

passage.text: Mint: Ha ha ha! That's so funny.
passage.reading: ˈmɪnt: ˈhɑː ˈhɑː ˈhɑː! ðæts ˈsoʊ ˈfʌni.

passage.text: Ploy: Why are you all sending laughing emojis?
passage.reading: ˈplɔɪ: ˈwaɪ ər juː ˈɔːl ˈsɛndɪŋ ˈlæfɪŋ ɪˈmoʊdʒiz?

passage.text: Ploy: My family is from the countryside, and honestly, I think this joke is offensive.
passage.reading: ˈplɔɪ: maɪ ˈfæməli ɪz frəm ðə ˈkʌntrisaɪd, ənd ˈɑːnɪstli, aɪ ˈθɪŋk ðɪs ˈdʒoʊk ɪz əˈfɛnsɪv.

passage.text: Pete: Relax, Ploy. It's just a joke.
passage.reading: ˈpiːt: rɪˈlæks, ˈplɔɪ. ɪts ˈdʒʌst ə ˈdʒoʊk.

passage.text: Nam: I agree with Ploy. Jokes about where people come from aren't funny.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm: aɪ əˈɡriː wɪð ˈplɔɪ. ˈdʒoʊks əˈbaʊt wɛr ˈpiːpəl ˈkʌm frəm ˈɑːrənt ˈfʌni.

passage.text: Mint: Sorry, Ploy. I didn't think about it like that.
passage.reading: ˈmɪnt: ˈsɑːri, ˈplɔɪ. aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈθɪŋk əˈbaʊt ɪt ˈlaɪk ˈðæt.

passage.text: Pete: Good morning, everyone. I want to say something about last night.
passage.reading: ˈpiːt: ˈɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ˈɛvriwʌn. aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈseɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈlæst ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: Pete: My joke was offensive, and I didn't think before I posted it.
passage.reading: ˈpiːt: maɪ ˈdʒoʊk wʌz əˈfɛnsɪv, ənd aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈθɪŋk bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈpoʊstɪd ɪt.

passage.text: Pete: Ploy, I'm really sorry. Please accept my apology.
passage.reading: ˈpiːt: ˈplɔɪ, aɪm ˈriːli ˈsɑːri. ˈpliːz əkˈsɛpt maɪ əˈpɑːlədʒi.

passage.text: Ploy: Thank you, Pete. I accept your apology.
passage.reading: ˈplɔɪ: ˈθæŋk juː, ˈpiːt. aɪ əkˈsɛpt jʊr əˈpɑːlədʒi.

passage.text: Nam: That was a good apology. Let's all be kinder in this group chat.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm: ðæt wʌz ə ˈɡʊd əˈpɑːlədʒi. lɛts ˈɔːl bi ˈkaɪndər ɪn ðɪs ˈɡruːp ˌtʃæt.
